title: The complete Crouzeix conjecture

result.label: The complete Crouzeix conjecture
result.statement: Resolves the complete Crouzeix conjecture: for every bounded operator A on a complex Hilbert space and every finite matrix-valued polynomial P , one has P[A] 2 z W(A) P(z) , where W(A) is the numerical range. The constant 2 is sharp, independent of the matrix size, and valid in infinite dimensions.
